config_string: kroupa_couette: TOTAL suspension viscosity via the wall force balance (Kroupa Langmuir 2016 eqs 26-33) in a two-way coupled plane-Couette cell: periodic x/y, moving z-walls u_x = +-G*L/2 (G=1), linear-shear IC. eta = eta_H (fluid wall stress) + wall lubrication + wall contact channels, cross-checked against the interior lubrication+contact virial. Stage per-phi rundirs by sed'ing volumeFraction_.
